decisions.reason: As a close-to-core pipeline component for the firm’s existing customers, it is cheap to keep as part of the range and still has clear strategic fit and option value.

This stand-alone public waste bin is relatively distant from the core infrastructure offer, and by 2022 the firm has likely learned enough to favor reallocating capacity to stronger core opportunities.
Although it uses the firm’s coating and fabrication capabilities and could appeal to municipalities, it remains a non-core line whose prospects should be sufficiently revealed after several years.
Outdoor public ashtrays are the most peripheral to the firm’s main solution business, so once uncertainty has largely resolved they are the most natural option to abandon.
